decisions.reason: The direct allocation impact is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY adding the 6.8 m² common-vestibule area to unit 1.
Allocating additional vestibule area to unit 1 does not change the three-dwelling count or unit 1's confirmed 2+1 configuration.
The source asks how to use a resulting large blue-marked area but establishes no new corridor treatment beyond the existing objective to reduce or productively use excessive corridor space.
The source allocates additional common-vestibule area to unit 1 but does not change the WC assignment, toilet positioning, or bathroom layout.
The vestibule partition and area allocation do not change unit 1's kitchen configuration, cabinet dimensions, or cabinet placement.
The source does not relocate the common entrance door or alter the requirement for independent unit entrance doors.
The unit 1 common-vestibule change does not affect unit 3's kitchen placement, cabinet dimensions, or bathroom-door clearance constraint.
The source contains no decision about bathroom placement, existing drains, or unit 3 drainage alignment.
The later partition adjustment does not alter the task-local definition or required content of the initial concept sketch.
The source concerns an interior common-vestibule partition and has no effect on balcony enclosure or retention.
The unit 1 vestibule allocation does not change unit 3's bathroom requirement, drain location, shower location, or fixture constraints.
The source does not change unit 2's bathroom position, centered door placement, or toilet positioning constraint.
